description: Every confirmed knowledge corpus of a Kingmaker release, listed file by file, so corpora can live outside the install payload (R2 bucket kingmaker-releases, library/ prefix) and stream in after install. This document is signed exactly like the release manifest: a detached base64 RSA-PSS/SHA-256 signature in kingmaker-library-manifest.json.sig, made with the offline release private key and verified by the installer and the app against the pinned release public key before any hash inside it is trusted. The manifest deliberately carries no signature field of its own. Paths are relative to the corpus sources root (~/Library/Application Support/sol-ghost/runtime/data/knowledge/sources once installed); each file also names its object key under library/ for fetching.

corpora.description: One entry per confirmed corpus (confirmed + licensed in the corpus bootstrap's TIER1 list; unconfirmed corpora never appear here).

field.description: The sources subdirectory the corpus lives under (knowledge.corpora.<i>.field in the release manifest): files land at <field>/<id>/... and receipts_complete checks the same path.

object.description: The object key on the update host: library/<id>/<path after <field>/<id>/>. The installer/bootstrap fetch <libraryBase>/<object-path remainder> per the contract in CHANGES.md.

path.description: Path relative to the corpus sources root, always beginning <field>/<id>/. No leading slash, no '..' segment (the installer refuses both).

id.description: Corpus id, as in the release manifest's knowledge.corpora and the .receipts/<id>.json receipt.

license.description: The corpus license recorded at intake (the Cage's license record). Required: a corpus without a license record is never listed.

totalBytes.description: Sum of this corpus's file sizes.

release.description: The release tag this library belongs to (e.g. "v0.4.1"). A library manifest from another release is refused.

totalBytes.description: Sum of every file size in every corpus. The stream/full choice on the install screen is sized from this (via the release manifest's knowledge.totalMB until the library manifest is fetched).

title: Kingmaker library manifest (signed)
